name: 把同一值的任意两项组合都算成不同 pair（C(freq,2)）
code:
import sys
d=list(map(int,sys.stdin.read().split())); n,k=d[:2]; a=d[2:]; ans=0
for i in range(n):
 c={}; pairs=0
 for j in range(i,n):
  v=a[j]; c[v]=c.get(v,0)+1; pairs+=c[v]-1
  if pairs>=k: ans+=1
print(ans)

name: 每种重复值只算一对，忽略第三、第四次出现
code:
import sys
d=list(map(int,sys.stdin.read().split())); n,k=d[:2]; a=d[2:]; ans=0
for i in range(n):
 c={}; pairs=0
 for j in range(i,n):
  c[a[j]]=c.get(a[j],0)+1
  pairs=sum(v>=2 for v in c.values())
  if pairs>=k: ans+=1
print(ans)
